description: Delete a file you own. The bytes are removed and existing share links stop working. Requires your API key.

api_key.description: Secret API key from signup. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass this only when you cannot set headers. Do not write it into a file you share.

file_id.description: File id returned by save_file, list_files, or share_file.

name: delete_file
title: Delete a file
